sources_described: Surface water from Booker Creek (003_003), located in the service area in Saratoga, treated by conventional surface water treatment (Table 10); Drinking Water Source Assessment Information printed as 'State Water Board'. Operated by Cypress Water Services. Drinking Water Watch lists the service area type as Summer Camp at 24500 Big Basin Way.

extraction_notes: The EAR portal serves this CCR only as a Word .docx (saved as reports/CA4300834/ccr-2025.docx, format docx); paragraphs and tables were read from word/document.xml with python3 -I, so 'pages' and per-row 'page' are null (the cached header field reads 'Page 5 of 9'). State SWS CCR template prepared by Cypress Water Services (Report Date 4/28/2026, monitoring period January 1 to December 31, 2025). Table 2 (lead and copper) has every data cell printed 'None' - no sampling results are given, so no lead or copper entries were created (only the AL 15 / PHG 0.2 and AL 1.3 / PHG 0.3 columns are filled). Table 6 (unregulated) is printed 'None'. Table 10's three turbidity performance standards were left as unfilled template placeholders. Table 8 groundwater rows are present although the source is surface water. Most rows print range 'NA' and use value_basis 'level detected'.
